demos.heading: Before you run anything: set up the shell
demos.purpose: DocuMind can answer a tenant's questions from four stores: its own Vector Search index (the ANN tier), the Firestore rung beneath it, or two managed mirrors, Vertex AI RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search. make up pins acme to RAG Engine and zeta to Vertex AI Search so every store the course teaches is exercised. A managed store holds the text of every current version, but not the kit's addresses: its citations come back with ids like acme:acme_497809ff...#rag-532341da71fe, a page of null even for a PDF, and stages.retrieval_backend: rag_engine. This lesson reads what a search hands the chat model, so point acme at the kit's own index for the duration, whose citations carry the kit's chunk ids and pages as the offline runs' do, and put the pin back at the end. Module 2 compares the four stores; Module 7 studies the mirrors.

demos.heading: On your lane: the model's own counter, and the probe
demos.purpose: Whether count_tokens on location global takes the declarations and the system instruction at all was not known when the kit was written. The probe settles it before any count on this page is trusted, for both forms of declaration: LangChain's parameters on the LangGraph brain, and ADK's parametersJsonSchema. The cell prints only each run's probe. Step 7 shows the whole of each run.
